support_intro: From your first dual-camera capture to saving and sharing. Find the essentials here, and get back to making something.
faq: devices
Which iPhones are supported?

Requires iOS 17.2 or later and an iPhone that supports simultaneous front-and-rear camera capture. The app checks support using the device's hardware and system capabilities; meeting the minimum iOS version does not guarantee multi-camera support. iPhone 11 has been used for physical-device validation. There is currently no iPad version.
permissions
Why does the app ask for these permissions?

Camera provides both views and captures media. Microphone records video sound. Add to Photos saves completed captures. The recent-capture preview uses the app's own files and does not scan your entire photo library. You can change these permissions in iOS Settings.
save
Where do my photos and videos go?

With Add to Photos permission, completed captures are automatically added to Apple Photos after processing. The bottom-left thumbnail opens your latest capture. After stopping video, allow processing and saving to finish; the local preview can open while Photos saving completes.
save-problem
What if I can't see my capture in Photos?

Allow processing to finish, then check Add to Photos permission in iOS Settings and available device storage. Reopening the app can resume handling retained files after an interruption. Keep the app and its data until an important capture has saved successfully.
window
How do I change the floating window?

Drag the window to move it, or pinch inside it to resize. Tap to cycle shapes, or hold to open the full style settings for size, shape, corners and borders. Stop recording before changing border or corner-radius settings.
sharing
How do I share a capture?

Tap the bottom-left thumbnail to open your latest capture, then Share at the top right. Choose an app or destination in the system share sheet and confirm the action yourself. Tap the video playback area to show playback controls.
language-theme
Where are language and theme settings?

Open the top-right gear. Language offers English, Simplified Chinese and Follow system. Theme offers light and dark. Settings also contains the privacy policy, app version and update date. Website languages are separate from the app’s language options.
delete
How can I delete local data?

Delete photo-library copies in Apple Photos. To remove app-local data, use Delete App in iOS Settings; Offload App may retain documents and data. Export anything you still need first. iCloud and shared copies are managed by the respective services.

policy_intro: How CaptureBoth uses system permissions, handles your captures, and lets you control and delete local data.
website_body:
This website serves static product information, help and privacy pages. It has no login, upload form, advertising or third-party analytics scripts and does not read your camera, microphone or photos.
When deployed on Cloudflare Pages, the hosting service may process technical information such as IP addresses, requests and traffic to deliver pages, secure the service and operate it. This is separate from the app's on-device capture processing.
If you choose to email support, we receive the email address, message and attachments you provide, to handle your request and necessary follow-up. Please do not send unrelated private media or sensitive information. To request correction or deletion of personal information in support correspondence, contact the support email; information required by law may be retained.
